events.description: Retraction Watch records Retraction (event type retracted; event ev-0071321; record 2081; row sha256 af15b784f4ff714fd9a93f9e4ec396bcc100b0c84c004f0a1aeb3a2b38675699). Notice date as reported: 2014-07-02 (raw '7/2/2014 0:00'; precision day; convention flags: MIDNIGHT_NOT_INSTANT). The source states a calendar day, not an instant: 00:00:00Z marks the day only.

limitations: CHECKED_SOURCES_ONLY: Only the checked sources were searched; a citation without a record in them is reported only as not found in the checked sources.
SNAPSHOT_COVERAGE: Results reflect the Retraction Watch snapshot rw-2f116e9ffed718e6; records added to the source after that snapshot are not covered.
OUT_OF_SCOPE_UNITS: 30 extracted unit(s) are outside detection scope (no DOI or PMID in a candidate role, or a definition not shown in the revision).
MARKERS_NOT_INTERPRETED: On-page markers such as retraction warnings are recorded but not interpreted.
OBSERVATION_ROLE_IDENTIFIERS_NOT_DECIDED: Identifiers in observation roles are recorded but not decided.
UNSTRUCTURED_TEXT_AS_STAGE03_DEFINES: Unstructured citations are read only as Stage 03 defines them.
V1_ONE_RECORD_PER_WORK: v1 holds one paper per record: the article-revision investigation is split into one record per positive work, each with the Stage 04 investigation id.
V1_CLASSES_PER_WORK: Stage 04 claim classes, rules, reasons and evidence chains of this work are in the Stage 04 report, not in v1.
V1_EVENT_DATE_IS_A_DAY: v1 events need an instant; Stage 02 notice dates are calendar days, so 00:00:00Z marks only the day (stated in each event's description).
